# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀掃描節點信件，輸出一行 JSON；不修復或修改輸入資料。

## 第一次跑

在原型根目錄執行：

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo /path/to/node --now 2026-10-09T12:00:00+02:00
```

`--now` 必填，必須是帶時區的 ISO 時間；工具不讀系統時鐘。成功時 stdout 僅有一行 JSON；路徑或時間不合法時退出 2，stdout 為空。

只掃描非隱藏信箱的 `inbox/*.md` 和 `inbox/done/*.md`，不遞迴、不跟隨符號連結。資料時間沒有時區時，使用 `--now` 的時區。無效信件列於 `bad`，不計入 `open` 或 `boxes`；同一 id 僅保留相對路徑字典序最前的有效信件。

測試指令：

```sh
python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests
python3 check_answer.py <proto7-2> fixture
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only mailtodo entry point."""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
import aos7_mailtodo
if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(aos7_mailtodo.main())

"""Black-box tests for the read-only mailtodo CLI."""
import json
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-09T12:00:00+02:00"


def message(id, status="REQUEST", to="z", at="2026-10-09T11:57:00", re=None):
    text = f"---\nid: {id}\nfrom: sender\nto: {to}\nstatus: {status}\nat: {at}\n"
    if re is not None:
        text += f"re: {re}\n"
    return text + "---\nbody\n"


def put(root, relative, text):
    path = root / relative
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def run(root, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(root), *args],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)


def snapshot(root):
    result = {}
    for path in [root, *sorted(root.rglob("*"))]:
        info = path.lstat()
        result[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = (
            stat.S_IFMT(info.st_mode), stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode),
            info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns,
            path.read_bytes() if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) else None)
    return result


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_summary_and_read_only(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1158-ask.md",
                message("ask", to="z", at="2026-10-09T11:58:30"))
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1157-wait.md", message("wait"))
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1159-progress.md",
                message("progress", "PROGRESS", re="wait"))
            put(root, "alice/inbox/20261009T1200-neg.md",
                message("neg", to="alice", at="2026-10-09T12:00:01+02:00"))
            put(root, "bob/inbox/20261009T1158-done.md",
                message("reply", "DONE", re="ask"))
            put(root, "bob/inbox/done/20261009T1157-archive.md",
                message("archive", to="q"))
            (root / "empty" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
            put(root, "alice/inbox/.hidden.md", message("hidden"))
            put(root, "alice/inbox/nested/20261009T1200-skip.md", message("nested"))
            put(root, ".hidden/inbox/20261009T1200-skip.md", message("hidden-box"))
            inbox = root / "alice" / "inbox"
            inbox.chmod(0o555)
            try:
                before = snapshot(root)
                result = run(root, "--now", NOW)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count("\n"), 1)
                data = json.loads(result.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(set(data), {"v", "open", "boxes", "bad"})
                self.assertIs(type(data["v"]), int)
                self.assertEqual(data["v"], 1)
                self.assertEqual(data["bad"], [])
                self.assertEqual(data["boxes"], {
                    "alice": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 3, "PROGRESS": 1}, "done": 0},
                    "bob": {"inbox": {"DONE": 1}, "done": 1},
                    "empty": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0}})
                self.assertEqual(data["open"], [
                    {"id": "neg", "from": "sender", "to": "alice",
                     "where": "inbox", "age_min": -1},
                    {"id": "archive", "from": "sender", "to": "q",
                     "where": "done", "age_min": 3},
                    {"id": "wait", "from": "sender", "to": "z",
                     "where": "inbox", "age_min": 3}])
                self.assertEqual(snapshot(root), before)
            finally:
                inbox.chmod(0o755)

    def test_invalid_files_priority_duplicates_and_empty_re(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            prefix = "a/inbox/"
            put(root, prefix + "20261009T1200-a.md", message("dup"))
            put(root, prefix + "20261009T1200-b.md", message("dup"))
            put(root, prefix + "not-a-date.md", message("dup"))
            put(root, prefix + "20261009T1200-no-front.md", "id: dup\n")
            put(root, prefix + "20261009T1200-no-field.md",
                message("other").replace("from: sender", "from: "))
            put(root, prefix + "20261009T1200-no-time.md",
                message("other", at="not-a-time"))
            put(root, prefix + "20260230T1200-date.md", message("other"))
            put(root, prefix + "20261009T1200-reply.md",
                message("reply", "DONE", re=""))
            put(root, prefix + "20261009T1200-last.md",
                "---\nid: last\nid: final\nfrom: sender\nto: z\n"
                "status: PROGRESS\nat: 2026-10-09T12:00:00\n---\n")
            before = snapshot(root)
            result = run(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(data["boxes"], {
                "a": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1, "PROGRESS": 1, "DONE": 1},
                      "done": 0}})
            self.assertEqual(data["open"], [
                {"id": "dup", "from": "sender", "to": "z",
                 "where": "inbox", "age_min": 3}])
            self.assertEqual(data["bad"], [
                {"file": prefix + "20260230T1200-date.md", "why": "bad_name"},
                {"file": prefix + "20261009T1200-b.md", "why": "dup_id"},
                {"file": prefix + "20261009T1200-no-field.md", "why": "no_field"},
                {"file": prefix + "20261009T1200-no-front.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"},
                {"file": prefix + "20261009T1200-no-time.md", "why": "no_field"},
                {"file": prefix + "not-a-date.md", "why": "bad_name"}])
            self.assertEqual(snapshot(root), before)

    def test_bad_cli_inputs_have_no_stdout(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            regular = put(root, "file", "text")
            for folder, args in (
                (root, ()), (root, ("--now", "bad")),
                (root, ("--now", "2026-10-09T12:00:00")),
                (regular, ("--now", NOW)),
                (root / "missing", ("--now", NOW))):
                with self.subTest(folder=folder, args=args):
                    result = run(folder, *args)
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                    self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")

# REPORT

新增唯讀 mailtodo 入口、解析器、README 與三項黑箱測試；索引列只指向新包。入口僅掃描指定兩層信件位置，不匯入既有寫入、修復或鎖定程式。無效信件依優先序列入 bad，重複 id 只保留首筆有效信件。

受限於此交付環境沒有執行工具，未宣稱測試或獨立核對已通過；須在原型環境實際執行後確認退出碼、固定答案及 fixture 唯讀性。

## 以後交接書該點名的工具

`python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests` 跑實質測試；`python3 check_answer.py <proto7-2> fixture` 獨立核對答案與唯讀。
